chunks: Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥusayn and ʿAlī ibn Muḥammad, from Sahl ibn Ziyād, from ʿAlī ibn Mahziyār, who said:

I wrote to him: ‘O my Master! A man is given some wealth with which he is to perform hajj. Is khums due upon him regarding that wealth when it comes into his possession, or upon what remains in his hand after the hajj?’
So he عليه السلام wrote: ‘Khums is not upon him.’

key_terms.الْخُمُسُ: the one-fifth tax due on certain categories of wealth
key_terms.فَضَلَ: what remained or was left over
key_terms.مَالٌ: wealth or money given for a purpose

ai.seo_question: Is khums due on money given to someone specifically to perform hajj?
ai.summary: This hadith addresses a legal question about khums on wealth given to a person specifically for performing hajj. The Imam عليه السلام replies that khums is not due upon him in this case, indicating a ruling concerning entrusted or designated funds for worship.
